🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 11, 2026

Moon, in Libra, holds a trine to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. Two air placements agreeing on the terms: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon opposes you from Libra, and the account has two columns. Fire that starts things, billed for starting. Four weeks of Cancer ended, and nothing carried over.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Mercury faces you from Scorpio, holding the other figures. Earth that holds on, charged for holding. Venus turned back two weeks ago; the review is still running.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Libra, Moon concedes the point early. Mutable air keeps two accounts, and both balance. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Libra. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. The hold Jupiter had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Libra, without leverage of its own. From Libra, Moon hands you an opening. Fire keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The Virgo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Mercury has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Air starts and settles in the same breath. Venus is 5° further on than in early October, which is barely further on.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. The sextile to Sun that held two weeks ago has let go.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. Two weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, has no support in Aries and asks twice for half. Moon squares you from Libra, and the cost objects. Cardinal earth: the beginning has a price on it. Moon let go of it two weeks ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Libra, Moon agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Fixed air: nothing needs letting go of today. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Venus in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. It arrived inside the last seven days.
